name: Osteoid Osteoma
definition: Small benign osteoblastic bone tumor, often affecting adolescents and young adults, classically causing severe nocturnal pain relieved by NSAIDs.

investigations.principle: Thin-slice CT is highly sensitive for identifying the nidus; MRI may show disproportionate edema.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Image-guided radiofrequency/thermal ablation in suitable symptomatic lesions
amber: Spinal lesions near neural structures require specialized planning.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-granthi phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Small benign osteoblastic bone tumor, often affecting adolescents and young adults, classically causing severe nocturnal pain relieved by NSAIDs.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
